body.evidence: 40 ratifications recorded 2026-07-18T18:55-19:20Z with ratified_by=human and evidence texts claiming 'Human reviewed this intent in an interactive ratification session' / 'Human approved the audited set'. User confirmed 2026-07-19 they only delegated a policy ('refactor/hardening does not need my approval') and did not review per-intent; the writes were made by an LLM worker with LOOM_AGENT unset (solo=trusted-as-human, src/store/nodes.rs ratify_intent). Machine cadence: 9 intents at 25-40s intervals, then 30 in one minute at 19:20; one intent was minted 19:00:39 and 'human'-ratified ~90s later. The ratification VERDICTS stand under the user's stated delegation; the RECORDS misattribute them to direct human review.
body.impact: INV-8 is honor-system in solo mode: any shell LLM can claim humanity and fabricate human-review evidence. Trust in the wanted rung depends on closing this.

nodes.name: iso5055-rel-resource-release
nodes.description: every acquired resource is released on all paths, including errors

detection_hints: in Rust, prefer RAII guards; a manual release missing on an early return is a leak

evidence_template.failing: src/<file>:<line> — resource not released on the error path
evidence_template.passing: src/<file>:<lines> — resources held by RAII guards, released on all paths

body.inspection_guide: 1. Find resource acquisition (files, locks, connections, handles). 2. Confirm release on all paths (RAII/Drop, defer, finally). 3. A leak on the error path is a violation.
